title: Efficacy and Safety of Alflorex Bei Reizdarm in Patients With Irritable Bowel Syndrome
brief_summary: This Post-Market Clinical-Follow Up (PMCF) study gains data on the efficacy and safety of "Alflorex bei Reizdarm", a probiotic based on Bifidobacterium longum 35624, in the daily use by irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) patients. The aim of this study is the observation of the influence of "Alflorex bei Reizdarm" on typical symptoms, severity score and quality of life of IBS patients in medical practice and everyday use.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Adult, diagnosed IBS patients with typical IBS symptoms (abdominal pain, bloating, gas, constipation or diarrhea) and physician's recommendation to take the study medication (probiotic with B. longum 35624) for 8 weeks

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
study_population: IBS patients of general practicioners and gastroenterologists
